sources.entry: Frappe HR - Complete HRMS solution with over 13 different modules right from employee management, onboarding, leaves, to payroll, taxation, and more. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Python/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: Frappe HR (frappe/hrms) is an open-source HR and payroll management application built on the Frappe Framework, covering employee lifecycle, leave and attendance, expense claims, performance management, and payroll.
summary.what_it_does: Frappe HR is a self-described complete HRMS with over 13 modules. The README highlights employee lifecycle tracking (onboarding, promotions, transfers, exit interviews), leave policies with regional holiday import, and attendance check-in/check-out with geolocation capture. It also covers expense claims and employee advances with multi-level approval workflows that integrate with ERPNext accounting, plus performance management with goals, KRAs, and self-evaluation for appraisal cycles. Payroll features include salary structures, income tax slabs, standard and off-cycle payroll runs, and income breakup on salary slips. A mobile app is mentioned for leave approval, check-in/out, and viewing employee profiles. The README describes it as built on Frappe Framework (Python and JavaScript, with a REST API) and the Vue-based Frappe UI library.
use_cases: Manage employee onboarding and exit processes
Track employee leave balances and attendance
Run monthly payroll and generate salary slips
Configure income tax slabs and salary structures
Process employee expense claims and advances
Run performance appraisal cycles with goals and KRAs
how_to_run: Log in as Administrator with password admin once the setup script creates the site
For local development: set up Frappe bench, then run bench new-site hrms.localhost, bench get-app erpnext, bench get-app hrms, and bench --site hrms.localhost install-app hrms
notable: Built on the Frappe Framework, with a REST API and database abstraction layer
Integrates with ERPNext accounting for expense claims
Covers payroll and income tax slab configuration in one app
Separate mobile app for leave approval and check-in/out
Originally a set of modules inside ERPNext, split into its own product from version 14
caveats: Local development requires a full Frappe bench setup and ERPNext installation
Managed hosting is offered through Frappe Cloud, which the README presents as a separate hosted service
Docker setup uses a default administrator password (admin), which should be changed for any real deployment
